 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
% 19.01.2023
1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of Fir No.754/2017 under sections 498A/406/34 Ipc
registered at Ps Shahbad Dairy on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vi
de Compromise Deed dated 14th January, 2020 arrived at between them with the facilitation of Counseling Cell, Family Courts, Rohini District Courts (North), Delhi, which is on record of this Court.

entities.text: Counseling Cell, Family Courts, Rohini District Courts (North), Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. As per the FIR, petitioner no.1 was married to respondent no.2 on 2nd March, 2002 but due to disputes and differences, the marriage was dissolved by mutual consent vide decree of divorce dated 7th September, 2021.
Two children were born out of this wedlock.
3. Petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2-complianant are present in the Court and have been duly identified by their respective counsels as also the IO.
Remaining petitioners, who all are senior citizens, are not present today.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceeding of the present FIR as the complainant has settled all disputes with the petitioner.
Consequently, the aforementioned FIR and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
It is however made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the children in future 5.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
